interface.title: 河区调度模型 — 19 河区逐日供需调度 (hydro-district, Hydro Toolkit)
interface.field: Hydrology / water-resources management (regional river-network water allocation, eastern Zhejiang plain districts)
interface.stage_of_work: Running a scenario simulation and analysing its results (daily water-balance scheduling and post-run review and export)
interface.what_it_is_for: Runs a daily water supply–demand balance for 19 river districts, reports total demand, inflow and shortage, and lets the user browse, filter, plot and export each district's daily balance and storage table.

data.note: Used the sidebar button '▶ 使用内置样例数据运行' (run with built-in sample data). The sample covers 8 days, 2025/09/04–2025/09/11. Baseline totals: 19 districts, total demand (总需水量) 9,381.2, total inflow (总来水量) 4,770.2, total shortage (总缺水量) 4,645.3. No upload test files were provided (browser_list_files was empty), so the ZIP path was never run. A sample-data quirk: 河网供水 (river-network supply) has the same daily values (2.526, 1.463, 1.254 …) in most districts.

children.general: Find which sub-regions are in deficit and by how much, by stepping through each sub-region in turn (the tool has no cross-region summary of deficits)
children.specific: The app offers no cross-district shortage view, so the ranking was built by hand: go through all 19 河区 with the 缺水(浙东需供) column shown and sum each one. Shortage over 8 days: 江北镇海平原区 ≈790.7, 慈溪平原中河区 ≈721.6, 慈溪平原东河区 ≈640.0, 虞北平原上河区 ≈460.1, 慈溪平原西河区 ≈441.7, 丰惠平原区 ≈362.0, 余姚平原下河区 ≈321.5, 余姚平原上河区 ≈293.1, 余姚平原姚江上游区 ≈278.7, 余姚平原姚江下游区 ≈261.1, 余姚平原马渚中河区 ≈55.0, 虞北平原中河区 ≈19.8 (only 09/04–09/07). Zero shortage: 南沙平原区, 绍虞平原区, 海曙平原区, 蜀山平原区, 鄞州调水区, 舟山大陆用水区, 姚江沿线大工业用水区. These add up to ≈4,645.3. Caveats: the explorer originally worked out 余姚平原下河区 (≈321) from the reported total because its 09/11 row was cut off (7 of 8 days seen = 318.9); the replay then read the 8th day (2.5205) and got 321.47. The replay re-summed only 8 of the 19 districts (江北镇海, 丰惠, 余姚上河, 姚江上游, 余姚下河, 虞北中河, 绍虞, 鄞州) and all 8 matched; the other 11 sums were not rechecked.

children.general: Inspect how a sub-region's storage is operated day by day against its target
children.specific: Show only 日期, 目标容积, 日初容积, 日中容积, 日末容积, 缺水(浙东需供), 河区排水. Example: 余姚平原姚江上游区 starts each day at 2856.245 (target 2858.7), drops mid-day to as low as 2773.5 and is topped back up by shortage supply. 虞北平原中河区 rises above its 611.43 target from 09/08 with no shortage. 鄞州调水区 has zero target storage and drains all inflow as 河区排水.
